articles.title: Global Market: Samsung, SK Hynix payouts put South Korea’s corporate reform to the test
articles.content: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix’s massive shareholder-return plans are putting South Korea’s efforts to narrow the “Korea discount” While investors welcome payouts worth over 130 trillion won, concerns remain over corporate governance, capital allocation and minority shareholder rights, with the KOSPI still trading at a steep valuation discount to regional peers.

articles.title: Molbio Diagnostics shares rally 30% in 2 days, jump 80% since debut. What lies ahead?
articles.content: Molbio Diagnostics shares have surged nearly 30% in two sessions, extending their post-listing gains to around 80% from the IPO price. articles.title: Global Market: South Korean stocks fall over 1% as Middle East tensions weigh on risk sentiment
articles.content: South Korean shares fell over 1% on Thursday as escalating Middle East tensions and attacks near the Strait of Hormuz weighed on investor sentiment. The KOSPI declined 1.37%, with major technology and heavyweight stocks including Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Samsung BioLogics falling, while foreign investors remained net sellers.

articles.title: US Treasury yields hit highest level since 2023 as buyback disappoints
articles.content: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields touched their highest level since November 2023 before easing after strong auction demand. Rising oil prices and shifting Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations added to concerns over inflation and the interest-rate outlook.

articles.title: Dilip Buildcon shares rally 12% on bagging Rs 1,800 crore LPG pipeline project

articles.title: India bonds face twin drag from rising oil, US yields
articles.content: Indian government bonds weakened for a second day on Thursday. Rising U.S. Treasury yields and crude prices above $100/barrel fueled inflation concerns. Focus remains on upcoming inflation prints and the Fed's policy decision.

articles.title: Why Jefferies is bullish on Manipal Hospitals after its ₹9,000 crore acquisition spree
articles.content: Manipal Hospitals’ acquisition-led expansion is entering a key phase, with Jefferies initiating coverage with a Buy rating and Rs 870 target. The brokerage expects strong earnings growth, driven by the turnaround of Sahyadri Hospitals, new bed additions, higher utilisation and operating leverage. However, execution risks at Sahyadri and intensifying competition in Bengaluru remain key concerns for the investment case.

articles.title: CDSL’s IPO jackpot comes with a valuation catch. Jefferies sets Rs 1,315 target

articles.title: IRB Infrastructure shares rally 8% as August toll revenue surges 25% YoY to Rs 807 crore
articles.content: Shares of IRB Infrastructure Developers surged up to 8% after the company reported a 25% YoY rise in toll revenue to Rs 807 crore in August 2026, supported by strong traffic growth and tariff revisions. Key projects, including the Mumbai-Pune Expressway and Ahmedabad-Vadodara Expressway, also recorded healthy revenue growth, offering a positive operational trigger for the stock.

articles.title: Enviro Infra Engineers shares rise 5% on Rs 224 crore wind EPC order from Tata Power RE

articles.title: NSE unlisted shares vs Nifty: Where did investors make more money ahead of mega IPO?
articles.content: Since September 2021, NSE unlisted shares have surged by over 170%, vastly overshadowing the Nifty 50 index's rise of just 35% within the same timeframe. articles.title: Too many IPOs, limited cash: How investors should allocate money across multiple issues
articles.content: India's primary market is bustling with a surge in initial public offerings, making it a tough landscape for investors. With numerous options vying for scarce capital and focus, it’s essential for investors to evaluate the quality of businesses and their financial health diligently. Emphasizing sound valuation practices and thorough fundamental analysis is vital for informed choices, as prioritizing growth potential and reducing debt fosters better allocation of resources.
